an5.251:1.1: chaṭṭhapaṇṇāsakaṃ. 1. upasampadāvaggo 5. 6. 1. 1. [upasampādetabbasuttaṃ] [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbaṃ.
an5.251:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti,
an5.251:1.8: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā upasampādetabbanti.
